Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 6, 2026 · Governing jurisdiction: Alberta, Canada · PIPEDA compliant

Your information stays with your order. We don't sell, rent, or share your personal information for marketing purposes. What you share with us is used to process and deliver your order — nothing more.

01

What We Collect

We keep it straightforward — we collect what we need to get your order to you and keep you informed about it.

Identity
Name as provided at checkoutOrder placement
Contact
Email addressOrder placement
Shipping
Delivery address within CanadaOrder placement
Payment
Payment method type, transaction reference. We do not store full card numbers.Checkout — processed by payment provider
Order history
Products ordered, order amounts, order statusOrder placement and fulfilment
Technical
IP address, browser type, pages visited, device typeAutomatically via website visit
Communications
Messages sent to our support team via emailWhen you contact us

We don't ask about your research, your institution, or how you're using the materials. That's your business.

02

How We Use Your Information

  • Order processing and fulfilment — processing payment, preparing your order, and coordinating domestic shipping
  • Order communications — confirmation emails, shipping notifications, tracking updates
  • Customer support — responding to inquiries about your order, documentation, or account
  • Website improvement — understanding how our website is used to improve functionality and content
  • Legal compliance — maintaining records as required under applicable Canadian law
  • Fraud prevention — detecting and preventing fraudulent transactions or account activity
03

Sharing Your Information

We don't sell your information. We share only what's needed to get your order fulfilled, with the people doing the work.

  • Shipping carriers — your name, delivery address, and contact information are shared with Canada Post to fulfil domestic shipments
  • Payment processors — payment details are handled by our secure payment provider. We do not store full card numbers. Your billing statement will show EPPIX
  • Fulfilment operations — order data is shared with our fulfilment system operated by EPPIX
  • Communication platforms — contact information is shared with approved email service providers for order communications
  • Analytics tools — non-identifiable usage data may be processed by analytics platforms to improve website performance
  • Affiliated entities — personal data may be shared within affiliated Eppix entities where all parties comply with this Privacy Policy
04

Cookies & Analytics

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to maintain session state, remember preferences, and understand how visitors use the site.

  • Essential cookies — required for the website to function. Cannot be disabled.
  • Analytics cookies — collect non-identifiable data about page visits, session duration, and general usage patterns.
  • Functional cookies — remember preferences such as cart contents and session information.

We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking for marketing or behavioural targeting purposes.

05

Data Security

  • All data transmitted between your browser and our website is encrypted via SSL/TLS
  • Payment information is processed by our payment provider — full card numbers are never stored on Eppix Labs servers
  • All communication between our systems is server-to-server with signed API requests and authentication tokens
  • Access to order and customer data is restricted to authorized personnel only
06

Data Retention

  • Order records — retained for a minimum of 7 years for tax, accounting, and legal compliance purposes
  • Account information — retained while your account is active, and for a reasonable period following account closure
  • Support communications — retained for 2 years following resolution of the inquiry
  • Analytics data — retained in aggregated, non-identifiable form
07

Your Rights

Your information belongs to you. Here's what you can ask us to do with it:

Right to Access

Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you at any time.

Right to Correction

If your information is inaccurate or incomplete, request that we correct it.

Right to Deletion

Request deletion of your personal data, subject to our legal retention obligations.

Right to Withdraw Consent

Withdraw consent for optional communications at any time by contacting us.

Right to Complain

File a complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

Right to Portability

Request your personal data in a structured, commonly used format where feasible.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at hello@eppixlabs.ca. We will respond within 30 days.

08

Children's Privacy

Our website and services are not directed at individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a person under 18, contact us immediately at hello@eppixlabs.ca and we will delete it promptly.

09

Policy Changes

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. When we make material changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the website following any update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

10

Contact & Privacy Requests

Questions about your information, or want to update, access, or remove it? Just get in touch:
